title: LLM Agent Implementations and Orchestration
summary: This module provides various implementations of LLM agents, including conversational, ReAct, and OpenAI function/tool calling agents. It defines core agent abstractions, utilities for agent creation, execution, and output parsing, enabling complex, multi-step interactions with language models and external tools.

nodes.label: Define Base Agent Logic
nodes.title: Agent Base Classes
nodes.description: Provides the fundamental structure and abstract methods for all agents, handling planning, intermediate steps, and interaction with LLM chains and output parsers.

nodes.label: Categorize Agent Types
nodes.title: Agent Type Enumeration
nodes.description: An enumeration defining various strategies and types of agents, such as Zero-Shot ReAct, Conversational ReAct, Self-Ask with Search, and OpenAI Functions.

nodes.label: Implement Chat Agent
nodes.title: Chat Agent
nodes.description: A specific agent implementation designed for chat models, extending the base Agent class with chat-specific prompt formatting and output parsing.

nodes.label: Implement Conversational Agent
nodes.title: Conversational Agent
nodes.description: An agent implementation focused on maintaining a conversation while utilizing tools, featuring specific prompt structures and output parsing for dialogue.

nodes.label: Implement Conversational Chat Agent
nodes.title: Conversational Chat Agent
nodes.description: An agent designed for conversational chat scenarios, integrating tools and managing chat history within its planning process.

nodes.label: Run OpenAI Assistant
nodes.title: OpenAI Assistant Runnable
nodes.description: A runnable component that interfaces directly with the OpenAI Assistants API, managing threads, runs, and tool calls within the OpenAI ecosystem.

nodes.label: Orchestrate Multi-Function Agent
nodes.title: OpenAI Multi-Functions Agent
nodes.description: An agent specifically designed to leverage OpenAI's multi-function calling capabilities, allowing it to invoke multiple tools in a single turn.

nodes.label: Implement ReAct TextWorld Agent
nodes.title: ReAct TextWorld Agent
nodes.description: A specialized ReAct agent tailored for text-world environments, focusing on interaction with a single 'Play' tool.

nodes.label: Implement Self-Ask Search Agent
nodes.title: Self-Ask With Search Agent
nodes.description: An agent that breaks down complex questions into simpler sub-questions, using a search tool to find intermediate answers before formulating a final response.

nodes.label: Implement Structured Chat Agent
nodes.title: Structured Chat Agent
nodes.description: An agent designed for structured chat interactions, capable of handling tools with multiple inputs and producing structured outputs.

nodes.label: Implement XML Agent
nodes.title: XML Agent
nodes.description: An agent that processes and generates XML-formatted output, using XML tags for tool calls and final answers.

nodes.label: Create Conversational Retrieval Agent
nodes.title: Conversational Retrieval Agent Factory
nodes.description: A factory function to construct a conversational retrieval agent, integrating an LLM, tools, and memory for chat-based retrieval tasks.

nodes.label: Create Vector Store Agent (Deprecated)
nodes.title: Vector Store Agent Factory (Deprecated)
nodes.description: A deprecated factory function for creating agents that interact with vector stores via a toolkit. Users are advised to migrate to newer tool-calling methods.

nodes.label: Create Vector Store Router Agent (Deprecated)
nodes.title: Vector Store Router Agent Factory (Deprecated)
nodes.description: A deprecated factory function for creating agents that route queries to multiple vector stores. Users are advised to migrate to newer tool-calling methods.

nodes.label: Initialize Agent Executor (Deprecated)
nodes.title: Generic Agent Initialization (Deprecated)
nodes.description: A deprecated function for initializing an AgentExecutor given tools and an LLM, supporting various agent types. Users should use `create_agent` instead.

nodes.label: Create JSON Chat Agent
nodes.title: JSON Chat Agent Factory
nodes.description: A factory function to create an agent that uses JSON for formatting its logic, specifically built for chat models.

nodes.label: Implement MRKL Chain (Deprecated)
nodes.title: MRKL Chain (Deprecated)
nodes.description: A deprecated chain implementation of the MRKL (Memory, Reasoning, Knowledge, Language) system, providing a user-friendly way to initialize an agent with specific chains.

nodes.label: Create OpenAI Functions Agent
nodes.title: OpenAI Functions Agent Factory
nodes.description: A factory function to create an agent that leverages OpenAI's function calling capabilities, binding tools to the LLM for structured interactions.

nodes.label: Create OpenAI Tools Agent
nodes.title: OpenAI Tools Agent Factory
nodes.description: A factory function to create an agent that uses OpenAI's tool calling feature, allowing the LLM to invoke defined tools.

nodes.label: Create ReAct Agent (Deprecated)
nodes.title: ReAct Agent Factory (Deprecated)
nodes.description: A deprecated factory function for creating agents based on the ReAct prompting strategy. Users are advised to use newer `create_agent` functions.

nodes.label: Implement ReAct Chain (Deprecated)
nodes.title: ReAct Chain (Deprecated)
nodes.description: A deprecated chain that implements the ReAct paper, integrating an LLM with a docstore for reasoning and acting.

nodes.label: Create Self-Ask Search Agent
nodes.title: Self-Ask With Search Agent Factory
nodes.description: A factory function to create an agent that employs the self-ask with search prompting strategy, requiring a single 'Intermediate Answer' tool.

nodes.label: Implement Self-Ask Search Chain (Deprecated)
nodes.title: Self-Ask With Search Chain (Deprecated)
nodes.description: A deprecated chain that performs self-ask with search, integrating an LLM with a search chain for intermediate answers.

nodes.label: Create Structured Chat Agent
nodes.title: Structured Chat Agent Factory
nodes.description: A factory function to create an agent optimized for structured chat, supporting tools with multiple inputs and structured output.

nodes.label: Create Generic Tool-Calling Agent
nodes.title: Generic Tool-Calling Agent Factory
nodes.description: A factory function to create a flexible agent that uses tools, requiring an LLM with a `bind_tools()` method and a message formatter.

nodes.label: Create XML Agent
nodes.title: XML Agent Factory
nodes.description: A factory function to create an agent that uses XML for formatting its logic, processing tool calls and responses within XML tags.

nodes.label: Parse Conversational Output
nodes.title: Conversational Output Parser
nodes.description: Parses the output from conversational agents, distinguishing between final answers and tool actions based on predefined patterns.

nodes.label: Parse ReAct JSON Output
nodes.title: ReAct JSON Single Input Output Parser
nodes.description: Parses ReAct-style LLM outputs that contain a single tool input in JSON format, extracting actions or final answers.

nodes.label: Parse Structured Chat Output with Retries
nodes.title: Structured Chat Output Parser with Retries
nodes.description: An output parser for structured chat agents that includes retry logic, optionally using an output fixing parser to correct malformed outputs.

nodes.label: Convert Agent Action to Messages
nodes.title: Agent Action to Message Converter
nodes.description: Converts an agent action object into a sequence of base messages, typically used to reconstruct the original AI message from the action log.

nodes.label: Create Function Call Message
nodes.title: Function Message Creator
nodes.description: Transforms an agent action and its observation into a FunctionMessage, which represents the result of a tool invocation.

nodes.label: Format Intermediate Steps to Tool Messages
nodes.title: Intermediate Steps Formatter
nodes.description: Converts a sequence of (AgentAction, tool output) tuples into a list of ToolMessage objects, suitable for sending to an LLM for the next prediction.

nodes.label: Filter Function Arguments
nodes.title: Function Argument Filter
nodes.description: Extracts and filters arguments from a function's signature based on a Pydantic model, excluding specified arguments or injected types.

nodes.label: Infer Tool Schema from Runnable
nodes.title: Tool Schema Inference
nodes.description: Infers the argument schema for a tool from a runnable's input type hints or explicitly provided argument types, creating a Pydantic model.

nodes.label: Execute Async Retriever Tool
nodes.title: Asynchronous Retriever Function
nodes.description: An asynchronous function that invokes a retriever to fetch documents based on a query and formats the results, optionally returning content and artifacts.

nodes.label: Language Model
nodes.title: BaseLanguageModel
nodes.description: The core abstraction for all language models, providing methods for text generation and interaction.

nodes.label: Agent Tool
nodes.title: BaseTool
nodes.description: The base abstraction for tools that agents can use, defining their name, description, and how they can be invoked.

nodes.label: Prompt Template
nodes.title: BasePromptTemplate & Variants
nodes.description: Abstractions for creating and managing prompts, including chat-specific and structured prompt templates, and placeholders for dynamic content.

nodes.label: Runnable Interface
nodes.title: Runnable & RunnablePassthrough
nodes.description: The fundamental interface for composable components in LangChain, allowing for chaining and parallel execution of operations.

nodes.label: Agent Execution Orchestrator
nodes.title: AgentExecutor
nodes.description: A component responsible for orchestrating the execution of an agent, managing its interaction loop with tools and LLMs.

nodes.label: LLM Interaction Chain
nodes.title: LLMChain
nodes.description: A chain that takes a prompt template and an LLM, formats the prompt, and passes it to the LLM for generation.

nodes.label: Output Parser Abstraction
nodes.title: AgentOutputParser & BaseOutputParser
nodes.description: Base classes for parsing the raw string output from an LLM into structured data, such as agent actions or final answers.

nodes.label: Message Abstraction
nodes.title: BaseMessage & Variants
nodes.description: Core abstractions for different types of messages (e.g., AI, Human, Function), used in conversational contexts.

nodes.label: Agent Action/Finish Types
nodes.title: AgentAction & AgentFinish
nodes.description: Data structures representing an agent's decision to take an action (tool call) or to provide a final answer.

nodes.label: Callback Management
nodes.title: Callbacks & BaseCallbackManager
nodes.description: Mechanisms for handling events during the execution of chains and agents, enabling logging, monitoring, and custom actions.

nodes.label: Agent Memory
nodes.title: AgentTokenBufferMemory & ConversationTokenBufferMemory
nodes.description: Components for managing and storing conversational history or intermediate steps, allowing agents to maintain context.

nodes.label: Pydantic Data Model
nodes.title: Pydantic BaseModel
nodes.description: A data validation and settings management library, used for defining structured inputs and outputs for tools and agents.

nodes.label: Document Data Structure
nodes.title: Document
nodes.description: A fundamental data structure representing a piece of text content, often with associated metadata, used in retrieval and processing.

nodes.label: Output Fixing Parser
nodes.title: OutputFixingParser
nodes.description: A parser designed to attempt to fix malformed LLM outputs by re-prompting the LLM or applying heuristic corrections.

nodes.label: Tool Description Renderers
nodes.title: Tool Description Renderers
nodes.description: Utilities for converting tool definitions and agent logs into formatted strings or messages suitable for inclusion in LLM prompts.

nodes.label: Tool Format Converters
nodes.title: Tool Format Converters
nodes.description: Functions to convert generic tool definitions into specific formats required by different LLM APIs, such as OpenAI functions or tools.

nodes.label: Tool Input Validation
nodes.title: Tool Input Validation
nodes.description: Utility functions to validate that tools provided to an agent meet specific requirements, such as having single inputs.

nodes.label: Document Store Explorer
nodes.title: DocstoreExplorer
nodes.description: A utility for interacting with a document store, providing methods to search and lookup terms within the store.

nodes.label: External Search APIs
nodes.title: Search API Wrappers
nodes.description: Wrappers for various external search APIs (e.g., Google Serper, SerpAPI), enabling agents to perform web searches.

nodes.label: Agent Toolkit Abstractions
nodes.title: VectorStoreToolkit & VectorStoreRouterToolkit
nodes.description: Abstractions for collections of tools, specifically designed for interacting with vector stores or routing queries among them.
